title: GhostNet-AI inference request

frame_id.description: Frame identifier. Defaults to the image filename stem.

image.description: The frame itself: a multipart file part, or a URL the AI service can fetch. NOT a local filesystem path. When the backend and the AI run on different machines, a path valid on one is meaningless on the other.

latitude.description: GPS latitude of the towfish at this ping.

longitude.description: GPS longitude of the towfish at this ping.

heading_deg.description: Course over ground in degrees, 0 = north.

altitude_m.description: Towfish height above the seabed. Required for slant-range correction.

nadir_col.description: Image column directly beneath the towfish.

range_resolution_m.description: Metres of SLANT range per pixel, across-track.

along_track_res_m.description: Metres per pixel row. Without it there is no length estimate.

layback_m.description: Horizontal tow-cable offset behind the GPS antenna.

x-notes: Coordinates are emitted only when latitude, longitude, heading_deg, altitude_m, nadir_col and range_resolution_m are ALL present. Otherwise localization is 'none' and a warning explains why.
